about: Hand-checked by Claude, 2026-10-13: the 116 Italian rows in the Animals and Countries lessons (Sept 2026 dump). 'wrong' = the word is wrong or untranslated for the lesson's sense. Capitalisation is left to a mechanical sweep and not scored. 'debatable' rows are left out of scoring.

wrong.221: Killer Whale -> Balena assassina is a word-for-word calque (Italian: orca)
wrong.41269: Turkey (country) -> tacchino is the bird (Italian: Turchia)

debatable.168: Drago di Komodo is common; varano di Komodo is the zoological name
debatable.200: Puzzola is the polecat, though widely used for skunk; moffetta is the skunk
debatable.41280: Sud Africa is seen; Sudafrica is standard
